config.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Lorian’s Arch Orbit
config.lorian_arch_orbit.reach_extension: Enable the client side of extended block interaction. A compatible server is still required.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.e: Enable primary, secondary and temporary item palette wheels.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.enab: Tap for vanilla pick block, or briefly hold to open the smart-pick wheel.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.connected_textu: Repairs missing end faces between connected block models.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.invisible_block: Enable client-side visualization controls for barriers and light blocks.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.reach_extension: Requested distance from 5 to 128 blocks. The server-confirmed value remains authoritative.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.connected_textu: Repairs inner wall-arm faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard wall states.
Repairs joining faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard bed states.
Repairs joining faces for vanilla and mod blocks using the standard door states.
Restores exposed horizontal faces where stacked glass panes have different outlines, including corners.
Restores the missing joining side when one half of a double chest is no longer present.
Repairs the contacting faces of extended normal and sticky piston bases and heads.
Completes the four narrow Nether Portal edge faces.
Completes the End Portal bottom and four side faces.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.a: Choose clockwise reveal, simultaneous expansion, or no animation.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.p: Select the built-in layout used for a new primary wheel file and Restore Defaults. Existing custom content is not overwritten.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.s: Select the built-in layout used for a new secondary wheel file and Restore Defaults. Existing custom content is not overwritten.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.palette_wheel.e: Edit primary and secondary groups. Draft changes are written only when Save is pressed.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.mode: Choose adjacent, range, or contextual candidate selection.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.scan: Maximum radius around the targeted block; the supported maximum is 3.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.cand: Maximum contextual candidates shown, from 8 to 24.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.hold: Milliseconds before Pick Block enters smart-pick mode; defaults to 100.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.hist: Give a small contextual score bonus to recently selected materials.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.smart_pick.debu: Log visited positions, valid samples, unique candidates, scored candidates, and scan time. Disabled by default.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.invisible_block: Remember whether supported invisible blocks are currently shown.
Include barrier blocks when visualization is active.
Include light blocks and their level when visualization is active.
Allow enabled features to display compact contextual HUD elements.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.restore_default: Reset every option in this screen to its safe default. Changes apply only after Save.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.error.yacl_miss: YACL is required to open the configuration screen.
config.lorian_arch_orbit.error.reload: Configuration reload failed; the last valid values remain active.
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Palette editor
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.preview: Select a group with members to preview it
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.default: Both layers use the built-in defaults selected in YACL; Cancel still discards this change.
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.builtin: The built-in group was restored to its default value.
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.saved: Both palette layers were atomically saved and applied.
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.save_fa: At least one layer failed to save. Check the log and use reload to recover.
palette_editor.lorian_arch_orbit.compone: The current world's component registry is unavailable.
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Share custom palettes
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.name: Share package name
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.instruct: Select custom or modified groups to share. P is primary and S is secondary.
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.empty: There are no custom or modified groups to share.
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.copied: Share code copied to the clipboard.
palette_share.lorian_arch_orbit.exported: Exported %s; its full path was copied.
palette_import.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Import palette share
palette_import.lorian_arch_orbit.instruc: Reads a clipboard share code and JSON files from the directory below.
palette_import.lorian_arch_orbit.empty: No valid share code or JSON file was found.
palette_import.lorian_arch_orbit.read_fa: Could not read the share directory: %s
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.title: Block gradient
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.color_hint: Enter six hex digits, e.g. #E0C9A2, or choose a block stop.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.steps_hint: 2–128 samples including endpoints. Adjacent segments share a stop; the last stop needs no length.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.color_space_: OkLAB matches perceptual color distance; RGB matches the three color channels.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.face_hint: Match only textures available on the selected faces.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.select_group: Select a group in the wheel editor first.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.replace_hint: Replace blocks in “%s”. Undo is available in the editor; save to commit.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.held_missing: Held block is not indexed or is filtered out. Change the block or filters.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.no_candidate: No matching blocks. Change the facing or block set.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.generated: Generated %s blocks, including repeated positions. Choose a target and apply.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.invalid_inpu: Use six hex digits and a length of 2–128 per segment.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.too_few: Permanent groups need at least two distinct blocks. This result can still be used in the temporary wheel or inventory.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.block_hint:
%s
%s
Texture: %s
Click to use as the current stop.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.checking_cac: Checking for updates; cached data is available.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.cached: Update failed; using valid cached data. Refresh to retry.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.unsupported: No upstream data for this game version. Refresh later.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.download_fai: Download failed. Check your connection and Refresh.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.applied: Applied %s blocks (%s duplicates removed). Undo is available; Save to commit.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.restore_inve: Restore overwritten items, including counts and components, from before these temporary operations. Clears the backup. Changing player invalidates it.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.temporary_hi: Preserve every position and repeated block. Tap the wheel key three times, hold the third, scroll to replace the held block immediately, release to close. Original items can be restored. Resets on restart.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.temporary_ap: Applied %s positions to the temporary wheel. Return to the game and triple-tap the wheel key.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.inventory_to: Inventory holds at most 36 results. Use the temporary wheel; results are never truncated or merged.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.inventory_hi: Overwrite hotbar slots with the first 9 results, then main inventory, up to 36. Preserve duplicates and back up overwritten items for one-click restoration.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.inventory_ap: Placed %s blocks in generated order. Use Restore items to roll back.
hueblocks.lorian_arch_orbit.hide_repeats: On by default. Hide only consecutive copies of the same block in the preview. Updates immediately without regenerating. Inventory and temporary wheel applications keep every generated position.
